skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: King rallies his own resolve, restoring own HP by 150% (+10) ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: King fires up the Imperial Engine, inflicting [Panic] on the main target (sealing 2 energy for 1 turn). Dispels the [Unyielding]/[Tenacity] of the 3 enemies with the highest max HP and re-applies it downgraded to a [Tenacity] effect worth 60% of the dispelled value, and restores HP to the 2 lowest-HP% allies by 300% (+10) ATK.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Panic] energy sealed 2 > 3Dispel/downgrade target — 3 highest-max-HP enemies > all enemiesDowngraded [Tenacity] power 60% > 50%Allies healed — 2 > 4 lowest-HP% allies, 300% (+10) ATK

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%.At battle start, raises the SPD of allies in the same row to 90% of King's SPD (if an ally's own SPD is already higher, it is unchanged).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start — also raises own SPD by 16%Same-row allies' SPD raised to 90% of King's SPD

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start — own SPD raised 16% > 20%Same-row allies' SPD raised to 90% > 95% of King's SPD

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc:
Summon drone at start of match (ATK &HP are 100% & 800% respectively of King's ATK). Drone will absorb 90% of all types of DMG received by King (excluding emblem and reflect effect) until its HP is 1%. Drone will follow up (after allies move) on 1 random enemy (350% ATK, up to 2 times each round).
Pic credits to Gibrah Noah

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Control status interrupts the target's actions.
The shield absorbs damage up to a portion of the subject's Health; Charge DMG ignores it.
